Admission/discharge and examination dates; 16 first-recorded-eligible stays with concordant acute-component/POA-absent candidates.

Date-only laboratory observations lack first result availability. Candidate intervals do not establish first MACE after 24 or 48 hours; complete negative capture and cardiovascular cause of death remain unverified.
5,744 matched source-record occurrences, 5,415 stay-day keys and 2,246 patients; 68,581 inpatient-course/discharge narrative fields were re-read. Death-time records are also present.

Narrative dates and death-time bindings require clinical adjudication and episode-clock conflict resolution. Cardiovascular cause and first-event eligibility remain unverified; neither a POA field nor a phrase establishes an event-free risk set.
Hospital admission/discharge clocks; LABEVENTS CHARTTIME; structured admission death time.
DIAGNOSES_ICD supplies no onset or POA clock. CHARTTIME is not first release; death time is not cardiovascular cause. Unreviewed notes could contain additional clues.
Unchanged source material adds no event-onset or verified assay-unit dictionary.

The broader follow-up found 127 occurrences of an onset-named key: 123 empty and four day-level infection dates, not MACE onset. No source field establishing first clinical result availability or complete diagnosis capture was found (section S2).
All were in examination-report lists, not laboratory lists. They cannot replace LIS result-availability times.

The four matching MIMIC transfer probability vectors and complete historical environment locks were not recovered. Later record recovery identified a historical MIMIC environment query and UMAP installation versions (section S3); the exact historical SHAP version remains unresolved.
Zero records have HH:MM precision. These processed fields cannot reconstruct 0/24/48-hour ordering.

Zhou et al 2020 [1]
4,309 oncology patients at Cleveland Clinic; 838 post-therapy de novo CTRCD labels.
De novo CTRCD after cancer therapy; no single fixed horizon. Features summarize all available records, including longitudinal echocardiography.
100 repeated 81/9/10 random training/validation/test splits. A separate calendar-time evaluation was also reported; the quoted AUC is from repeated random splits.
Selected logistic regression: AUC 0.802 (95% CI 0.797-0.807). Five algorithms included gradient tree boosting, not specifically XGBoost.

Li et al 2025 [2]
419 patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors in 2020-2023.
Cardiac biomarker or ECG abnormalities within 30 days after treatment initiation, not attributable to other disease; baseline inputs.
XGBoost AUC 0.83; logistic regression 0.80; random forest 0.74. AUC intervals are not supplied in the accessed abstract.

Zhang et al 2026 [3]
2,500 cancer survivors receiving systemic antitumour therapy at Jilin Cancer Hospital; 188 incident CVD events.
Post-treatment incident CVD; models at 1, 2 and 3 years, including tumour and treatment inputs.
Internal random holdout with 10-fold optimization. The article reports both 75/25 and 70/30 split proportions.
XGBoost AUC 0.666, described as the 3-year value in Results and as an average in the abstract. No interval is given for this estimate in the accessed text.
Original a-e distributions and cohort structure were retained with corrected analysis units and labels. Unsupported survival panels f-h were removed.
The original transfer matrix and within-cohort AUROCs in A/B were retained. Panels c-e were removed because record order does not establish event-aligned chronology.
The original descriptive SHAP, correlation and UMAP panels were retained. Causal and biological-equivalence interpretations were removed.

Original principal ROC data are retained in reconstructed panels; invalid proxy-score comparisons were withdrawn. Figure 4 combines the retained a-f analyses and g-i summaries in one 3-by-3 layout: g compares historical and patient-isolated AUC, h reports simple and all-input missingness comparators, and i reports original-input 0/24/48-hour measurement-window AUC. These are distinct retrospective analyses. Base-model calibration is evaluated separately with pointwise intervals.
Original Chinese A/B rankings were retained. Model-version-mismatched MIMIC panels and the universal monitoring-panel claim were removed.

Retained content appears in current Supplementary Figures S5, S6 and S20–S25. The invalid archived S9H fold-change panel is withdrawn. The historical aggregation legends are corrected, and the main Figure 3 versus current Supplementary Figure S25 Albumin source-field and complete-pair differences are disclosed.
